description: Defines an abstract interface class `AudioFrameBuffer` in the `cuttlefish::webrtc_streaming` namespace for handling audio frame data, with pure virtual methods for audio properties and data access.

classes.name: AudioFrameBuffer
classes.description: An abstract interface class for audio frame buffers, providing methods to access audio properties and data.

methods.name: bits_per_sample
methods.description: Pure virtual method returning bits per sample of the audio frame.

methods.name: sample_rate
methods.description: Pure virtual method returning the sample rate of the audio frame.

methods.name: channels
methods.description: Pure virtual method returning the number of audio channels.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Pure virtual method returning the number of frames.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Pure virtual method returning a pointer to the audio data.
